patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — ClickUp and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose ClickUp only if your buying job matches “All-in-one configurable Work OS (tasks, docs, dashboards, ClickUp Brain) — Unlimited from ” rather than Smartsheet's shape. Choose Smartsheet only if your buying job matches “Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/memb” rather than ClickUp's shape. Workflow advantage: ClickUp leans team-collaboration-work; Smartsheet leans resource-planning, timeline-reporting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — ClickUp and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: ClickUp is All-in-one configurable Work OS (tasks, docs, dashboards, ClickUp Brain) — Unlimited from $7/user/mo annual.; Smartsheet is Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/member/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: ClickUp (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Smartsheet (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: ClickUp-leaning team-collaboration-work vs Smartsheet-leaning resource-planning, timeline-reporting.
- Researched limits: ClickUp — Configuration sprawl without admin standards; Smartsheet — No free plan.

Limitations — ClickUp: Configuration sprawl without admin standards; AI Brain packaging can add cost beyond Unlimited floors; Smartsheet: No free plan; Business tier pricing jump.

Poor-fit cases: ClickUp is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Configuration sprawl without admin standards · Smartsheet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan · Avoid ClickUp if you actually need Smartsheet's motion (Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
